_comment: Single source for plugin identity and host adapters. Edit here, then run python3 scripts/workflow.py render (writes every host manifest and skills/sdlc/references/hosts.md). Every host uses the plugin by reference (hosts[].install); host facts behind these choices: adapters/HOST-NOTES.md.

plugin.name: sdlc-workflow
plugin.description: Goal-scoped product delivery, refinement and defect repair with shared role tasks, versioned dependencies, independent review and execution evidence.

description_i18n.en: Goal-scoped product delivery, refinement and defect repair with shared role tasks, versioned dependencies, independent review and execution evidence.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 按目标组织完整交付、局部打磨和缺陷修复：共享角色任务、版本依赖、独立审查与运行证据。

marketplace.name: sdlc-workflow
marketplace.description: Local marketplace whose only entry is this plugin directory (Claude Code and Grok; Codex reads .agents/plugins/marketplace.json).

interface.shortDescription: Product delivery, scoped refinement and verified defect repair
interface.longDescription: Goal-scoped product delivery, refinement and defect repair with shared role tasks, versioned dependencies, independent review and execution evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use SDLC Workflow to take this feature through the gated swimlane.
Use SDLC Workflow in product mode to refresh the product layer.
Use SDLC Workflow in refine mode to improve this requirement and stop at an accepted handoff.
Use SDLC Workflow in fix mode to repair and verify this defect.

hosts.label: ZCode
hosts.install: the plugin directory itself: ~/.zcode/local-plugins/sdlc-workflow (a clone, or a symlink to one)

hosts.label: Claude Code
hosts.install: settings only: a `directory` source under `extraKnownMarketplaces` (project-relative or absolute) plus `enabledPlugins`; loads in place. Never `claude plugin install` (it writes a cache copy)

hosts.label: Grok
hosts.install: a symlink in a trusted project's `.grok/plugins/` (listed in `[plugins].enabled`) or in `~/.grok/plugins/`, or a `[plugins].paths` entry. Never `grok plugin install` (it keeps a hashed copy)

hosts.label: Codex
hosts.install: `python3 PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/link-codex.py --project <root>`: `<root>/.codex/skills/sdlc-workflow` → `skills/` and role agents in `<root>/.codex/agents/`, this project only (without `--project`: `$CODEX_HOME`, every project). Never `codex plugin add` (it installs a copy and drops symlinks)
hosts.commands: none — Codex plugins carry no commands; see the command table below
hosts.skill_call: read the listed SKILL.md (Codex lists `sdlc-workflow:<name>`); users pick it with `$` or `/skills`
hosts.read_only: typed agents: sandbox_mode = "read-only" (verify effective settings); untyped collaboration fallback needs a verified read-only parent/session

hosts.label: Kimi Code
hosts.install: `python3 PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/link-kimi.py --project <git root>`: individual skill and role symlinks in `.kimi-code/skills/` and `.kimi-code/agents/`, project only. Never `/plugins install` (user-level managed copy)
hosts.commands: project links: `/skill:<name>` + `mode:`; distribution manifest also declares `/sdlc-workflow:<command>`
hosts.skill_call: Skill tool `<name>` (drop the logical `sdlc-workflow:` prefix); users type `/skill:<name>`
hosts.read_only: reviewer/qc tool allowlist + disallowedTools; all roles set subagents: []
